testName: Advance Opportunity Stages via Lightning Sales Path
steps:
1. Open Opportunities tab
2. Click on New button
3. Enter "Global Media - Expansion Q3" in Opportunity Name
4. Select Stage "Prospecting"
5. Select Close Date as end of next month
6. Enter "150000" in Amount field
7. Click on Save button
8. Click on Stage "Qualification" in Lightning Sales Path
9. Click on "Mark as Current Stage" button
10. Verify Stage updates to "Qualification"
11. Click on Stage "Proposal/Price Quote" in Sales Path
12. Click on "Mark as Current Stage" button
13. Verify Stage updates to "Proposal/Price Quote"
